finding.accepted_feedback: The submission12 videos directionally support obstacle-local slowdown: all three tracks finish, but 13 of 26 rendered obstacle encounters lose at least 10 percent on the video speed proxy and recovery commonly lags 0.4 to 0.8 seconds.
finding.code_mechanism: After miss frames 1 through 4 retain target30, the fifth latch-clearing frame can immediately restore the stronger generic curve supplement for one decision before the faster clear-curve path becomes eligible on the next frame.
finding.rejected_feedback: Intentional off-road driving was not implemented. The official environment penalizes prolonged negative reward, terminates on playfield exit, and uses lower grass friction; the available official material does not establish a safe competitive allowance for leaving the road.
finding.unproven: Rendered video lacks physical speed, policy-camera frames, actions, clearance and source/package binding, so it does not justify a global target-speed increase, weaker obstacle-approach braking, shorter latch duration or more aggressive steering.

candidate_effect.scope: Only the fifth latch-clearing frame after a previously qualified far/moderate compound obstacle.
unchanged: near, extreme-sweep, strong-steer, reversal and lost-road behavior
candidate_effect.illustrative_action: At target34, speed40 and excess5.5, control brake0.159 becomes0.119; inherited base brake0.072 remains a hard floor.

static_validation.differential_coverage: Both turn directions and obstacle sides; exact miss1-4 behavior; fifth-frame-only effect; sixth-frame reconvergence; y/sweep/steering boundaries; reacquisition, flicker, reversal, reset, invalid/lost-road handling; 64 randomized stateful sequences; finite actions; gas/brake exclusivity; base-brake floor; maximum relief0.04.
static_validation.audit_result: No blocking implementation, protocol, routing or safety mismatch found.

performance_evidence.note: An environment command was started accidentally and terminated before result emission; no output, cell result or performance evidence from it was retained or used.

governance.blocker: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent, so RULES.md blocks environment performance evaluation, submission and promotion.

residual_risk: Five detector misses do not prove that the vehicle has physically cleared the obstacle. The bounded brake-only change therefore remains a static diagnostic candidate until an authorized, source-bound closed-loop evaluation measures finish, collision, off-track, clearance and lap-time outcomes.
